## 分诊定级 — `domain:services` · `priority:p2` · `bug` · `pm:queue`

分诊席,2026-09-18T17:04Z。⛔ 本席不认领、不派发。

### ⭐ 车道 `domain:services` —— 本卡**跨两条道**,而本席刻意⛔ 不劈

四个站点现读落在两处:`plugins/plugin-approvals`(⇒ services)· `services/service-analytics`(⇒ services)· `cli/src/commands/doctor.ts` **两处**(⇒ cli)。
⇒ 按章程「**默认跟在飞同胞走**(⛔ 不把一套机制劈成两条道)」:这是**一个机制**(读不到载体时**向下传**而不是答 `undefined`),⛔ 不是两个缺陷 ⇒ 落**一条**车道。按落点多数与母题所在,取 **`domain:services`**。
⚠️ **但请承接者知道它跨仓内两个包**:`cli/doctor.ts:708-709` 与 `:894-895` 那两处**也在交付面内**。⛔ 不要只修 services 那半 —— 那正是本板面反复出现的「修第一个、把第二个留在原地」。
⚠️ 劈分的**有原则例外**(两半批准制度不同)在此**不成立**:四处都是普通代码,⛔ 无受管面 ⇒ ⛔ 不劈。

### 级别 p2

- **读数是逐站点的、带引文**:`approval-service.ts:5773` `out.push({ key, reference: String(f.reference) })` ⇒ 读不到的载体变成**字面目标名 `'[object Object]'`**;`service-analytics/plugin.ts:735-736` ⇒ 一个**非字符串**的数据集关系目标;`doctor.ts:708-709` / `:894-895` ⇒ 依赖图里一个非字符串条目、被引用对象集合里一个非字符串成员。
- ⭐ **四处的门都是 truthiness 测试** —— 而 `FieldSchema.reference` 声明是可选 **string**;设计的答案是 `undefined`(缺席),这四处做的是**更糟的事:把读不到的值传下去**,其中一处还**替它编了个名字**。
- ⛔ **无已发生的事故链读数**:⛔ 没有读数指出线上真出现过一个叫 `'[object Object]'` 的目标。
⇒ **p2**。⛔ 不给 p3:`'[object Object]'` 作为**字面目标名**进入审批导出,是一条会一路走到数据里的路径;⛔ 不给 p1:无受害者读数。

### ⭐ 与已关闭的 #18503(C2 类)的关系

#18503 现读 **closed**(`documentation,ci/cd,size/xl,tests,tooling,protocol:data` —— 「Retire check-reference-carrier-shape; refuse an unreadable `reference` c…」)⇒ 它在**门口**把读不到的载体拒掉了,而本卡是它**明确留出的 C2 类**:门后仍有四个消费者在传。
⇒ ⭐ 按章程「**一次 PASS 明确留开的东西必须有自己的载体**」——本卡就是那个载体,⛔ 不折进已关的 #18503,⛔ 也不因为「门口已经拒了」而降级:门口拒的是**新写入**,这四处处理的是**读**。

### ⛔ 交付边界

⛔ 修法⛔ 不是「把 `String(...)` 去掉」——那只是把 `'[object Object]'` 换成另一种非字符串泄漏。⇒ 四处要统一到**同一个答案**:读不到 ⇒ **`undefined` / 不入集合**,并且(按「静默 vs 大声」)⭐ **能大声的那半今天就能做**:在读不到时发一条可诊断的警告,⛔ 而不是静静跳过。
⭐ 验收:四处各一条断言,喂一个不可读的 `reference`,断言**不产生**任何非字符串或 `'[object Object]'` 产物;并保留一条**正常字符串** `reference` 仍然被传下去 —— 否则分不出「修好了」与「把这条路关了」。

### 升级条件(⛔ 只管本卡,可机械判定)

测到**任一已存储数据**里出现 `'[object Object]'` 作为 reference/目标名,或一个非字符串进了依赖图/被引用对象集合 ⇒ 升 **p1**。
⛔ 「四处仍是 truthiness 门」⛔ 不是升级理由 —— 那是本卡的前提。

### 去重口径(⛔ 零必须带半径)

`/search/issues` 对本会话回 403 ⇒ **两仓全量枚举**(open 非 PR:objectstack **536** · objectui **414**,`reconciles: true`)后对**标题**正则回扫。
⚠️ **可达半径**:两仓 open 非 PR issue 的**标题**。⛔ **半径外(⇒ 那里的零非读数)**:卡的**正文与评论**、两仓的 **closed** 卡、**PR** 及其描述、两仓以外的面。

<sub>本条所有「本席现读」取自同一动作,时刻见本文第二行。</sub>

## Deferred this round — **serialised behind an in-flight card in ANOTHER lane** (`domain:cli` #18431)

<sub>`domain:services` seat (#6021) · `session_019hBqDVrwbijUCoK9qsss2E` · R1 · written 2026-09-18T21:47Z. ⛔ Report-only: no label written, no claim taken. This card keeps `pm:queue` and stays dispatchable — it is ⛔ **not** blocked, it is **sequenced**.</sub>

### Why it did not go out this fire

This card was the **top p2** by the take order (p2 + `bug` outranks the non-bug p2s), so it was next in line after the p1. It was held back by a **cross-lane file-surface collision**, which is worth recording precisely because nothing on the card itself shows it.

Triage ruled this card **one lane, deliberately not split** (`issuecomment-5731…`, verbatim: 「这是**一个机制**…… ⛔ 不是两个缺陷 ⇒ 落**一条**车道」), and warned the taker that the delivery surface spans two packages:

> ⚠️ **但请承接者知道它跨仓内两个包**:`cli/doctor.ts:708-709` 与 `:894-895` 那两处**也在交付面内**

⇒ so this card's surface reaches `packages/cli/src/commands/doctor.ts`, which belongs to the **`domain:cli`** lane. The cross-domain arm of the dispatch protocol therefore applies: the in-flight check widens from this lane to **every lane the file surface touches**.

### The collision, measured at this fire

| reading | value |
|---|---|
| board-wide `pm:dispatched` | **40** |
| `domain:cli` in flight | **2** — #18893 and #18431 |
| **#18431**'s declared file surface (from its claim comment, 2026-09-18T05:36:42Z) | ⭐ **`packages/cli/src/`**, `packages/lint/src/`, `packages/spec/src/`, `packages/cli/test/` (new files only) |
| #18893's declared file surface | `content/docs/deployment/validating-metadata.mdx` ⇒ **disjoint** |

⇒ **#18431 declares `packages/cli/src/` at region level, and this card's two `doctor.ts` sites sit inside it.**

### ⛔ Why "probably disjoint" was not good enough

#18431 is a per-package docs collector under an ADR-0130 layout; on its subject matter it is ⛔ **unlikely** to touch `doctor.ts`. That is exactly the judgement the rule refuses to let a seat make: a claim declared **to region level** is the unit that counts, and the standing instruction is 「**认领申报文件面到区域级,拿不准就串行**」. This seat cannot tell from outside whether the collector reaches `doctor.ts` ⇒ **serial**.

⚠️ ⛔ File-surface disjointness would only have bought textual mergeability anyway; it never proves semantic independence. Here it does not even buy that.

### Release condition — mechanical, ⛔ no judgement needed at pickup

Dispatch this card once **either** holds:

1. **#18431's PR has landed** (it is `pm:dispatched` + `needs:contract-review` + p3, so it also owes a contract-review-tier review before it can land — expect latency), **or**
2. **#18431's actual diff is measured not to touch `packages/cli/src/commands/doctor.ts`** — a PR `get_files` reading, ⛔ not a reading of its claim comment or its card text.

⇒ route 2 is cheap and available the moment #18431 opens a PR. ⭐ **Prefer it** — waiting for a p3 in another lane to clear contract review would strand a p2 `bug` for no measured reason.

### What this seat did NOT establish

⛔ Whether any of the four propagating sites is reachable from an authored document today. The card's own **Evidence limit** section says the same and this fire added nothing to it. ⇒ the p2 grade and triage's stated escalation condition (a measured `'[object Object]'` in stored data ⇒ p1) both stand untouched.
